description: This file contains SQL functions for managing cloud resources and billing within a Supabase-backed application. It includes functions for notifications, auditing, billing snapshots, and retrieving billing summaries.

methods.name: notify_user
methods.description: Inserts a notification record for a user and logs the action in audit logs.

methods.name: compute_billing_snapshot
methods.description: Calculates and upserts a monthly billing snapshot for a user based on resource count. Also logs the update in audit logs.

methods.name: get_monthly_billing_summary
methods.description: Retrieves the current month's billing summary for the user, computing it if necessary.
